text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The night before the Takamatsunomiya 
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: *sneaking around...*

—Little pony, where are you off to so late 
at night?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Just kidding! Did I sound like them?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Y-Y-Yeeeeeowch~~!! Seriously, Fuji!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wait, why are you even here!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Because tomorrow I finally get to run 
with Ruby, right?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Like Helios would ever just stay in bed 
quietly! I knew for sure you'd sneak out!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Totally~☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"My eyes were wide open and glaring! I 
couldn't sleep a wink!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I get wanting to just run out the door, 
but do you have a gate pass?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Tee-hee, forgive me, pwease? ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I thought as much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"For times like these, we recommend this 
item: 'The Dependable Palmer-san'!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Right now, it comes with an 'Off-Campus 
Pass' & Trainer's personal notes! And the 
price is... a priceless friendship 
special!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Bestieeee!!!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: —Hm? Hey, hey, isn't that...!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —*pant*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: It's Ojo!! Ojooo—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Wait. Someone's coming.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: It was here after all.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You weren't there when I woke up, so I 
panicked for a second.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I sincerely apologize for causing you 
concern.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
As you can see, I am unhurt, so please get 
some rest. It will affect your tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"You're the one with a race tomorrow. You 
need to get some rest."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...I heard it's an important race.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, one must devote oneself to 
rigorous training.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, absolute and overwhelming 
results are demanded of me."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
From here on, constant victory is the bare 
minimum; beyond that, I must deliver 
performances that truly satisfy everyone.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Tomorrow in particular is the perfect 
opportunity to demonstrate the caliber of 
our family's bloodline.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
A race won by both my grandmother and my 
mother. I must seize victory in it no 
matter what...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ruby...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
My sincerest apologies. May I return to 
practice now?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll help out too. That way, you 
won't be able to overdo it, right?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Please. I'm just so anxious.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...May I ask something?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Why is it that you always look out for me 
so much?"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I'm... just like you. ...Right?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, time, please.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ! Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, sorry. I'm getting sleepy!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hey, shouldn't we head back after all? 
I'll brew some really nice herbal tea! 
What do you say?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yeah...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The long-awaited day of the 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen has arrived. 
However, Daitaku Helios seems to be acting 
strange.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's have a strategy meeting! 
At the vanity dresser!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ah, my bad! Sweatshirt!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, totally! Somen, so good... haha, get 
it?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her party-girl slang lacked its usual 
punch, and her energy seemed 
uncharacteristically low...
choice_data_list:
You're looking forward to running with 
Ruby, aren't ya?

You're looking forward to running with 
Ruby, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I'm super looking forward to it! But...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Like, I don't think ojousama even 
registers me in her field of view at all.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: And then I realized...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yeah!! I hate it so much!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
But I've got no clue what to do. Kinda 
feeling meh??

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list:
If you win, they'll have no choice but to 
look at you!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: It's for real!!!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I see, so I just gotta win... Then they'll 
be right in front of me, right!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Color contacts popped right outta my eyes! 
Trainer-pi, you're a genius!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: MAX HYPE!!!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Aye-aye, sir!!

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Lady Daiichi Ruby~! Please achieve the 
three-generation sweep!

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Lady Ruby's brilliant path begins here! 
She will surely deliver results today.

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Fan B
text_block_list.text: —Just like Mother!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ojo!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Ms. Helios.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
We're finally together☆ My heart's 
pounding like crazy too!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Let's have a ton of fun!
